participants.independence_basis: Independent logical primary-A configuration; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per item in an empty Git repository with the exact frozen prompt only; no candidate implementation or dataset curation participation. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

Independent logical primary-B configuration; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per item in an empty Git repository with the exact frozen prompt only; no candidate implementation or dataset curation participation. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

Independent logical grader; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per frozen packet in an empty Git repository; no primary, implementation or curation role. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

Independent logical adjudicator; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per necessary disagreement receives only the original frozen prompt before its answer is sealed; no primary, implementation or curation role. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.
